svg.aria-label: ADR-007: the persistent tier; weights semantic and procedural, the journal episodic; the life of an episode from the write path through the entry, the read path and the lifecycle; the journal survives a process restart from the disk alone, sealed per scope, durable first; the Molaison protocol is the milestone
svg.title: ADR-007 — The persistent tier: the organ that makes continuity measurable
svg.text: The persistent tier: an episodic organ outside the weights, surviving the session boundary
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-007. Weights are semantic and procedural; the journal is episodic; cut the journal and the episodes must vanish while the skills stay.
The weights: semantic and procedural
semantic and procedural memory; the model is stateless between sessions
except through the organ and its checkpoint: the thesis itself
The journal: episodic
what happened in a session; neither retrieval over documents nor a bigger context window:
the organ the continuity triad measures
The life of an episode
an episode
something that
happened in a
session, with its
provenance
the write path, the hippocampal pipeline
separate (decorrelate near duplicates) →
associate (reconstruct from the cue) →
compare (surprise, their distance) →
the gate in two stages: admission rejects
the redundant; the verdict is retrospective,
forgetting is its tribunal; each stage a flag
the entry, in an append only log
a cue (the address), a pointer (the content hash),
a salience, a schema, the times written and read,
a lifecycle state; the bytes live in a content
addressed store, never duplicated;
the size law bounds the entry; reads never scan:
a fixed size associative state and a cue index
the read path
a fourth path of the router: control,
energy, delta, journal; used only
where its predicted score beats the
control: the organ can never degrade
the model; no new router is built,
the contract gains one path
the lifecycle, on a rhythm
live → consolidated →
demoted, into a summary keeping
the pointers → evicted; a phase
every fixed count of admitted writes;
budgets as setpoints; the sentinel
check before every commit; an
eviction withdraws the address
Across the session boundary: after a stop and a relaunch of the process, from the disk alone

g.text: persistence is a property declared per component: the structure replayed from the append only log; the bytes in a
content addressed directory next to it; the index recomputed at open; the associative memory rebuilt from its own events
sealed at rest, per scope, with the hub's framing: a tampered line or file fails loudly; a sealed journal opened without
its key fails loudly; sealed by default, a plaintext scope is declared explicitly; the key is never read implicitly, never written
durable first: every mutation reaches the log, and a payload its file, before memory changes; never silent: a loss of
durability is visible in the declaration, the telemetry and to the caller; free disk space is a regulated variable
a storage policy per scope, in its hashed configuration: stop (consistency, for measurement runs), read only (reads continue),
memory (a bounded spill, declared not durable, flushed in order when the disk returns); the protocol never claims on a journal in memory
the restart test: write through the lifecycle, destroy every object, reopen in a new process: the episodes recalled, the sentinels
intact, the counts identical, sealed and clear; a boundary named in advance: when the memory lives in the weights, the model's
arm re declares this lifecycle and passes the restart test again before continuity is claimed

svg.text: The milestone: the Molaison protocol gives a number

g.text: facts written through the normal gated path; a second
session in a fresh context, with the journal and without it;
frozen thresholds, never adjusted after a number;
a negative control of never planted facts
cut the journal: recall collapses, skills hold
the pass is published either way; a fail is a result
and revises the memory story; the protocol then runs
at every checkpoint and doubles as the eviction
safety check: consolidate then evict must never silently
degrade skills or contracted recall

svg.text: Sequenced asynchrony: decided, not built
a sequence point decides a phase's plan and logs it; actions apply later, in order, durable first,
at a deterministic rate, each re checking its precondition when it applies; one plan in flight;
reads never wait and never see a half state; replay stays exact. Never a decision outside a sequence point.
Reuse, legality, trade offs
three built things reused: the associative layer as the completion stage, the data layer's hashing, the router;
the engine written from scratch; episodes carry provenance and never cross scopes; the classic system
trade offs read one by one: most decided and dated, two open and parked, one a recorded reserve

g.text: what enters
the gates and the schedule
the organ and its test
the weights, the guarantees across the boundary, the reuse
